definitions.explanation: A person who rides a horse, especially a professional jockey in horse racing. Can also refer more broadly to any mounted rider.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{騎手|きしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げた→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧。
examples.english: The young jockey achieved his first victory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{競馬|けいば}→競馬：00207_keiba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、{騎手|きしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腕前|うでまえ}→腕前：07299_udemae⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{勝敗|しょうはい}→勝敗：04905_shouhai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In horse racing, not only the horse's ability but also the jockey's skill greatly influences the outcome.

notes:
A compound of {騎|き} (riding, mounted) and {手|しゅ} (person, hand). In modern usage, primarily refers to professional jockeys in ⟦{競馬|けいば}→競馬：00207_keiba⟧ (horse racing). Japan has a well-established horse racing industry (JRA — Japan Racing Association), and famous jockeys are widely known public figures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {騎手|きしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a jockey
- {騎手|きしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{騎乗|きじょう}→騎乗：25138_kijou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a jockey rides (formal)
- {騎手|きしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腕前|うでまえ}→腕前：07299_udemae⟧: the jockey's skill
- リーディング{騎手|きしゅ}: leading jockey (most wins in a season)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ジョッキー: jockey — the loanword, used interchangeably in casual contexts
- ⟦{騎馬|きば}→騎馬：24597_kiba⟧: mounted warrior, horseman — historical or military term
- {乗|の}り{手|て}: rider — more general term for anyone who rides (horses, motorcycles, etc.)
